newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel rises with NYMEX heat, diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel rises with NYMEX heat, diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices again rose sharply by over a cent a gallon, though cash values in the key U.S. Gulf Coast production region eased a touch in light pre-weekend talk, traders said.
But cash differentials in the New York Harbor markets actually firmed, though no deals could be confirmed at those levels.
Traders noted prices have now nearly reached heady levels not seen since the days of the Gulf War in 1991.
USG and NYH 54-grade offers were heard at about 1.60 cents and 5.00 cents over October NYMEX heat respectively.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
